title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Incorrect Default… (CVE-2026-91895)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 have an Incorrect Default Permissions vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially tamper with information. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
